title: The Father's Emanations from the Five Members
description: A compact doctrine of how the Father's emanations come forth one beside another, each from a distinct intellectual faculty: from his mind, the Beloved of the Lights; from his thought, the Mother of Life; from his teaching, the Beloved; from his counsel, the Virgin of Light; and from his reflection, the fifth (lost). The discrete-degree procession of love, wisdom, and reception articulating the Divine Esse outward through five faculties as five emanations.
